input:
Traditional tale: 神农尝百草

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
神农和他的家人住在古代，所以不知道什么植物能吃。因为他的家人常常生病了，所以神农和他的哥哥一起去旅行找可以吃的植物。他们去很多不一样的地方，比方说高山、山谷和沙漠。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. After the family’s illness is mentioned, add Shennong’s feeling to show his motivation more clearly: “看着家人常常生病，神农心里很着急。”
2. When listing the places, add one visual detail to make the journey easier to imagine: “高山上云雾缭绕，山谷里长着许多植物。”
3. Before the journey, add a short line of speech showing the brothers’ purpose: “我们一定要找到能吃的植物！”

ideas.reason: This adds a fitting feeling that explains why Shennong wants to find edible plants.
“云雾缭绕” is an advanced literary expression for an early-level learner.
This short line naturally states the brothers’ purpose before they leave.
